audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0-4 of the chart disagreed with the whys sitting under them. The chart said Cassiopeia/Skill/Vladimir/Vladimir/Cassiopeia; the prose says even, hers, hers, hers, even — which is exactly the packet chart Skill/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Cassiopeia/Skill.
audit.why: Two independent sources (packet chart and the matchup's own prose) agree against the chart, so the chart is the wrong half. The mirror audit saw the same conflict and deferred it.
audit.corrected: Rows 0-4 aligned to the packet chart in matched full/content pairs, with ratings inverted to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns; 'Miasma's cooldown' was the pivot of nine instructions and never quantified.
audit.why: Miasma 24/22/20/18/16, Twin Fang 0.75s, Noxious Blast 3.5s at 850 range, Petrifying Gaze 120/100/80, against Sanguine Pool's 28s and Hemoplague's 120s. The 0.75s Twin Fang is why the DPS race is unwinnable while poisoned.
audit.corrected: Numbers written into phases[0..4], spikes[0], mid, early and breakdown.cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: 'Miasma zones your range and heals her' — Miasma does not heal, Twin Fang does. Anti-heal was never prescribed despite Twin Fang healing off every poisoned tick.
audit.why: The healing is the reason you lose the extended trade, and it lives on the ability you can actually itemise against. Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her, which the page did get right and is worth keeping explicit.
audit.corrected: Healing moved to Twin Fang, Grievous Wounds made the mid-game instruction, grounding described as grounding rather than zoning.

edits.before: Q-drain on cooldown — you trade HP like a loan shark. Identify how Cassiopeia contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Level 1 is even before Miasma. Noxious Blast is 850 range to Transfusion's 600 — take the chip, last-hit, and don't step up.

edits.before: Pool answers his single biggest button — save it for exactly that. Only take the trade when Cassiopeia's Miasma is down.
edits.after: Twin Fang plus poison already out-trades your Transfusion. Give ground, last-hit, and keep Sanguine Pool's 28s for her R.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Cassiopeia must walk into your range.
edits.after: Miasma grounds and slows you inside it while Twin Fang fires every 0.75s. Hold the wave near your side and give ground.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Miasma's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Poisoned, you lose the Twin Fang race. Anti-heal first — Twin Fang heals her off every tick — then farm to your first item.

edits.before: Hemoplague + empowered Q turns mid-game fights into resets. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Cassiopeia's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Level 6 evens out: Petrifying Gaze only stuns enemies facing her, and your first item lands here. Turn away and it is just a slow.

edits.before: - Cassiopeia Miasma: matchup-defining — Grounds you — dashes and movement abilities are disabled inside it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Miasma: 24s at rank 1 — grounds and slows, and grounding disables movement abilities inside it. - Twin Fang: 0.75s and it heals off poisoned targets, so buy anti-heal. - Petrifying Gaze: 120s, and it only stuns if you face her. - Sanguine Pool: 28s. - Hemoplague: 120s.

edits.before: Level 3 stays hers as Miasma zones your range and heals her.
edits.after: Level 3 stays hers as Miasma grounds you and Twin Fang heals her.

edits.before: Cassiopeia's Twin Fang plus Miasma spike is brutal: the poison ground zones your Transfusion range and Twin Fang machine-guns you while you're poisoned, healing her and out-DPSing your sustain.
edits.after: Cassiopeia's Twin Fang plus Miasma spike is brutal: Miasma grounds and slows while Twin Fang, on a 0.75s cooldown, machine-guns you through the poison and heals her past your sustain — rush anti-heal.

edits.before: Level 1 is even before Cassiopeia has Miasma; trade Transfusion for her Q and neither commits. Don't step on poison ground and keep your distance.
edits.after: Level 1 is even before Cassiopeia has Miasma; Noxious Blast is 850 range to your 600, so trade only once she has stepped up, and never stand in poison.

edits.before: From 2 through 5 Cassiopeia dominates: Miasma zones you and Twin Fang out-heals and out-DPSes your poke while you're poisoned. Dodge the ground, don't face her ult, and stall to items.
edits.after: From 2 through 5 Cassiopeia dominates: Miasma grounds and slows while Twin Fang fires every 0.75s on poisoned targets and heals her. Buy Oblivion Orb, dodge the ground, stall to items.

edits.before: Slow you with Miasma so you can't close or escape
edits.after: Ground you with Miasma so you cannot close or escape

notes: The packet suspectName 'Petrifying Gaze's' is a FALSE POSITIVE — correct name in the possessive. Level-chart conflict resolved here rather than deferred, because the packet chart and this matchup's own whys agree against the chart on all five rows.
